segments: Hey, that's the destruction of the flesh
because it's breaking you down because
now you are faced with your actions. But
pull pull the definition back up again.
Shame, a painful feeling of humiliation
or distress caused by the consciousness
of wrong or foolish behavior. Until that
brother gets kicked out or removed,
stood up and judged and then removed,
he's not going to be fully aware of the
consciousness of the wrongdoing that he
did. Therefore, he's not going to feel
the destruction of his flesh, which is
that painful feeling of
humiliation, aka the shame. Read again
verse 5. to deliver such un one unto
Satan for the destruction of the flesh,
that the spirit may be saved in the day
of the Lord Jesus. That's the beauty and
shame. that your spirit may be saved in
the day of the Lord Jesus.
